svg.title: Whose bits moved with the JDK
svg.desc: StrictMath: no change from JDK 21 to 25 or 25 to 26; pow changed on 1,258 inputs from 25 to 27. Math on an AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370: cbrt and tanh changed from 21 to 25, sinh from 25 to 26.
